title: The Laser I a Solarian Theoria swapped out goes back in beside its Laser II at Sol Central (own storage first), pulse laser stripped
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 08:49 UTC (orders ENT-081, block ZERO: strip off-role pulse lasers, batch-upgrade to Laser II/III (rules F17, F37: dominant fits in parallel batches, measured in flight).
